label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 128 ]

blocks.text: The e-business industry is faced with a labor shortage. Experts point out that this is a serious problem that could slow down the development of our economy. Industries are competitively changing their businesses into e-businesses, and thus the demand for the required workforce is expected to grow. A recent survey shows that there is a gap between the labor supply and demand in the e-business industry. This is not likely to change before 2005.

readingSentences.english: The e-business industry is faced with a labor shortage.
readingSentences.korean: 전자 상거래 산업은 인력 부족에 직면해 있다.

readingSentences.english: Experts point out that this is a serious problem that could slow down the development of our economy.
readingSentences.korean: 전문가들은 이것이 경제 발전을 느리게 할 수도 있는 심각한 문제라고 지적한다.

readingSentences.english: Industries are competitively changing their businesses into e-businesses, and thus the demand for the required workforce is expected to grow.
readingSentences.korean: 산업체들은 경쟁적으로 그들의 사업을 전자 상거래로 전환시키고 있으며, 따라서 필요한 인력에 대한 수요는 증가할 것으로 예상된다.

readingSentences.english: A recent survey shows that there is a gap between the labor supply and demand in the e-business industry.
readingSentences.korean: 최근의 한 조사는 전자 상거래 산업에서 인력 공급과 수요 사이에 격차가 있음을 보여주고 있다.

readingSentences.english: This is not likely to change before 2005.
readingSentences.korean: 이것은 2005년 이전에 바뀔 것 같지는 않다.
